recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow completion of an already-published R5 application in active source and does not require additional work-group review.
issue_request: FHIR-24870 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request for FHIR-core Claim. It asked to clarify Claim.referral so implementers know it is referral information received by the claim author, not a referral generated by the author, and that a copy of a generated referral may be provided as supporting information.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-24870 was found. Commit f952b5321d, an R5 Financial Management core update, appears to have applied the issue by changing Claim.referral's definition to the approved received-referral warning and mirroring that definition to ExplanationOfBenefit.referral, but both Requirements fields still contained only the old payer-proof sentence.
additional_context: Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit are active resources in source/fhir.ini. ExplanationOfBenefit was included because the prior application already mirrored the Claim.referral definition there and had the same missing Requirements update. Later referral-touching history did not alter the wording substantively, and focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related decision that narrowed or reversed the published Jira resolution.
reconciliation: Updated source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml and source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml so the referral Requirements fields include the approved guidance about received referral information, generated referrals, supporting information, and payer proof. Existing definitions were left unchanged because they already convey the requested guidance.
source_changes: source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml: updated Claim.referral requirements from the old payer-proof-only sentence to the full approved received-referral guidance.

source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml: updated the mirrored ExplanationOfBenefit.referral requirements to keep the previously mirrored Financial Management wording consistent.
